messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated TLS handshake failures observed from multiple customers to model-prod-west (proxy layer). Error rate spike started ~10:04 UTC. Pager duty triggered.

Jordan (oncall): on it. paging PD now, switching phone to do-not-disturb but monitoring here. anyone else seeing user reports?

Tess Support: we have 6 support tickets in last 5m, customers seeing 502 and connection refused. Ticket IDs: #4621 #4623 #4628. All in eu-west and us-west hitting prod-west endpoint.

Jordan (oncall): quick impact: are new deployments rolled out to prod-west in the last hour?

Mateo Eng: not from model infra side. last deploy was config-only 02:50 UTC. But we had automated cert rotation job scheduled at 09:58 UTC (cron: cert-rotator).

Priya SRE: I'm attaching logs from the proxy fleet (p-side):

```
2025-06-03T10:04:12Z proxy-01 TLS handshake failure: alert handshake_failure (SSL_connect)
2025-06-03T10:04:12Z proxy-02 TLS handshake failure: short read during SSL handshake
2025-06-03T10:05:02Z proxy-07 backend connect timeout to model-host-1: connection reset by peer
```

Jordan (oncall): run a quick curl from a bastion to see handshake details?

Priya SRE: running openssl to gather cert details:

```
$ openssl s_client -connect model.prod-west.redwood.ai:443 -tls1_2 -servername model.prod-west.redwood.ai
CONNECTED(00000003)
139754...7567:error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure:ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c:1544:SSL alert number 40
---
no peer certificate available
---
```

NOC Gateway: also seeing BGP flaps for the prod-west VPC peering at 10:03:xx UTC, repeating. Route updates dropping for a minute. Might correlate.

Mateo Eng: hmm. cert-rotator logs show attempts to push new cert to edge proxies at 09:58:03 but a subset failed with permission denied when writing /etc/ssl/certs/prod.pem

```
2025-06-03T09:58:03Z cert-rotator: push attempt -> proxy-02 -> ERROR: EACCES writing cert to /etc/ssl/certs/prod.pem
2025-06-03T09:58:04Z cert-rotator: push attempt -> proxy-04 -> OK
```

Jordan (oncall): hypothesis 1: partial cert rotation left some proxies with new cert and others with none/invalid, causing SNI mismatch/handshake failures and backend resets. hypothesis 2: networking BGP flaps caused some proxies to talk to stale backends with mismatched TLS. both are possible.

Anika (SRE Lead): prioritize rollback of cert to last known-good on the proxies that failed, and mitigate traffic via routing override to healthy proxies. Also we need timeline and logs in-thread. Jordan, assign tasks.

Jordan (oncall): Mateo, rollback cert on proxy-02 and proxy-07 to previous bundle (sha: abc123) and restart proxy process. Priya, gather tcpdump on proxy-02 for 10.03-10.10 UTC. NOC Gateway, hold peering config steady and share BGP logs. Tess, update customer-facing status page that we're investigating TLS handshakes.

Mateo Eng: starting rollback now.

ops-bot: Deployment rollback initiated by Mateo Eng for proxies [proxy-02, proxy-07]. CI job: rollback-2025-06-03-1009.

Priya SRE: starting tcpdump capture:

```
sudo tcpdump -n -i eth0 host 10.1.12.34 and port 443 -w /tmp/proxy02_tls.pcap
```

Jordan (oncall): Priya, paste the initial tcpdump summary here when you have it (SYN/SYN-ACK/RESET patterns).

Priya SRE: summary: lots of SYN, SYN-ACK, then immediate RST from local process. Also seeing TLS Alert 40 (handshake_failure) from proxies.

Priya SRE: dumping a small sample of packet bytes around handshake (hexdump):

```
0000: 16 03 01 00 2e 01 00 00 2a 03 03 5b ...
TLS Alert: 02 28 (handshake failure)
```

Tess Support: status update posted to status.redwood.ai: "Partial outage in prod-west affecting model requests; investigating TLS handshake failures. No data loss."

NOC Gateway: BGP logs attached:

```
2025-06-03T10:03:09Z route-flap: peer 172.31.8.5 withdraw 10.0.0.0/16
2025-06-03T10:03:11Z route-add: peer 172.31.8.5 announced 10.0.0.0/16
```

Jordan (oncall): interesting. Could be correlated but cert push failing still points to cert problem. Mateo, rollback result?

Mateo Eng: rollback completed on proxy-02 and proxy-07 at 10:12 UTC. restarted proxy service.

ops-bot: Services restarted on [proxy-02, proxy-07]. Health checks passing (3/3) as of 10:14 UTC.

Priya SRE: after restart we see handshake success for a subset of connections. TLS errors drop sharply in metrics around 10:15 UTC.

Jordan (oncall): visible customer impact: error rate reduced from 18% -> 2% by 10:18 UTC. Support ticket inflow slowed.

Anika (SRE Lead): good. hold for 15m to ensure stability. we'll keep investigating root cause: why did cert-rotator EACCES?

Mateo Eng: pushed a fix to cert-rotator: it was invoking scp under a different user due to a recent sudoers tweak; target machines had stricter ownership on /etc/ssl/certs directory. New change uses system-agent to write certs with correct uid (root) and verifies permissions pre-write. Change tested on staging.

Priya SRE: adding more evidence: file permissions on proxy-02 at 09:58 showed root-only write, cert-rotator ran as 'rotator' user -> EACCES. On proxies where push succeeded, there was prior manual chown to rotator user.

Jordan (oncall): hypothesis refinement: root cause = cert-rotator permission regression exposed divergent state across proxy fleet (some proxies had manual permission drift). BGP flaps likely exacerbated visible impact but not primary cause.

Anika (SRE Lead): agreed. action items for post-incident RCA:
- fix cert-rotator to always use system-agent for writes and validate perms before commit
- add canary check: after cert push, verify certificate chain and do a probe handshake to each proxy (not just push ack)
- remediation to detect and fix permission drift: run periodic audit job for /etc/ssl/certs ownership across fleet
- add alert correlation: if cert-rotator errors and BGP flaps within 5m, create high-priority incident automatically

Jordan (oncall): logging timeline to handoff: started at 10:03 UTC, cert-rotator failure observed at 09:58 UTC, spike in TLS errors at 10:04, rollback completed 10:12, errors reduced 10:15, stable by 10:30. handing off to night oncall Mateo at 10:40 UTC.

Mateo Eng: acknowledged handoff. I'll own the RCA doc and follow-ups. Adding preliminary notes to /docs/incidents/1748462010-rca-draft (will create doc and share link when ready).

Tess Support: notifying affected customers with postmortem ETA ~4 hours.

Anika (SRE Lead): please include MTU check in RCA — NOC noted no MTU errors but verify ENI config. Also include verification steps for peering stability during cert rotations.

ops-bot: Incident severity downgraded to sev-2 at 10:35 UTC.

Jordan (oncall): final quick checklist before handoff: confirm cert-rotator patch deployed to prod, propagation check run, audit job scheduled, customer comms drafted. Anything outstanding?

Mateo Eng: cert-rotator patch deployed to all rotator instances at 10:32 UTC. Running fleet-wide post-push probe now (will report).

Priya SRE: probe results: 99.9% handshake success across proxies at 10:38 UTC. minor outliers linked to hosts undergoing maintenance.

Anika (SRE Lead): thanks team. we'll capture this thread into the formal RCA and tag ops and security. leaving the channel open for followups.

incident-bot: Incident resolved for model-prod-west. Root cause: cert-rotator permission regression + fleet permission drift. Contributing factor: transient BGP peering flaps. Follow-ups assigned to Mateo Eng and Priya SRE.

Jordan (oncall): handoff complete. I am signing off until next shift. :thumbsup:
